mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and it is not disabled anywhere. This is reinforced by the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so no host, internal ones included, is exempt from TLS or from certificate verification.
EOF
